h1: B2B Lead Generation for Companies Selling to Hong Kong
intro: Looking for a lead generation partner for Hong Kong? Myntmore runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for B2B companies that want Hong Kong buyers in finance, trading and logistics, including Indian firms selling into Asia. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.
whyTitle: Why selling to Hong Kong needs outbound

why.title: A dense financial centre
why.desc: Central and Admiralty hold banks, asset managers and insurers whose buyers are pitched constantly. Specific, role-relevant outreach is what gets through.

why.title: Trading and logistics decision-makers
why.desc: Hong Kong's trading houses, sourcing offices and logistics firms buy for factories and customers across the region, so one meeting can open several markets.

why.title: Business runs in English and Chinese
why.desc: Most B2B buyers read English, and some prefer Chinese. We agree the language for each segment before launch.

stepsTitle: How B2B lead generation works with us

steps.title: ICP and buying signals
steps.desc: We define who to target and which signals mean they are in-market: new regional offices, funding, hiring, leadership changes and supplier reviews.

steps.title: Lists, domains and copy
steps.desc: Verified contact lists, dedicated sending domains with warm-up, and copy written for Hong Kong buyers, in English or Chinese as agreed.

steps.title: Campaigns go live
steps.desc: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences start sending in Hong Kong business hours, with account-based plays for named firms.

steps.title: Conversations, then consistency
steps.desc: First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we tune messaging on real replies.

stepsNote: Outreach rules for this market: Hong Kong's Unsolicited Electronic Messages Ordinance requires accurate sender details and an unsubscribe option in commercial email, and the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance governs personal data. We contact business decision-makers only, keep volumes low and honour every opt-out. Read our [cold email compliance guide](/resources/blogs/cold-email-compliance-guide). Comparing agencies?
